text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text includes obligations about displaying label details in advertisements, online configuration tools, and sales material, which are not present in the Italian text.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "The details included in the label as well as some further information also have to be displayed in advertisements, in online configuration tools and in sales material.", "before": "The label must be displayed in a clearly visible manner directly on the vehicle or in its immediate vicinity."}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "Italian text includes additional claims about CO2 targets, electric vehicle registrations, and fuel/CO2 decrease in 2020 that are not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "Gli importatori di veicoli nuovi raggiungono per la prima volta gli obiettivi relativi alle emissioni di CO2", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.8}, {"reason": "Italian text includes a claim about an adjustment of the energy label starting from January 1, 2023, which is not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "Adeguamento dell'etichettaEnergia per le automobili nuove a partire dal 1° gennaio 2023", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "Italian text includes a claim about an increase in electric car and van registrations in 2021, which is not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "Nuove immatricolazioni 2021: aumentano le automobili e gli autofurgoni elettrici", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}, {"reason": "Italian text includes a claim about a net decrease in fuel consumption and CO2 emissions of new cars in 2020, which is not present in the English text.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "Netto calo del consumo di carburante e delle emissioni di CO2 delle automobili nuove nel 2020", "before": ""}, "severity": 0.6}]}
